en: And then on my way back, I decided to stop at the grocery store because I have no food.
zh: 然后在我回家的路上，我决定顺路去趟超市，因为我完全没有吃的了。

en: Like I'm not even being dramatic.
zh: 我真的不是在夸张。

en: I think I have a bag of chocolate chips. That's about it.
zh: 我好像只剩下一袋巧克力豆了。就这些了。

en: I'm gonna do a little haul of what I got because I love grocery hauls
zh: 我要来分享一下我买了什么，因为我很喜欢看别人分享买菜。

en: because I like just getting inspo for meals.
zh: 我喜欢从中获取做饭灵感。

en: You guys know it's kind of hard for me sometimes to think of meal ideas.
zh: 你们知道吗，有时候去想要吃什么对我来说是件难事。

en: So I'm just gonna show you a few of the things that I got.
zh: 所以我就来展示一些我刚刚买的东西。

en: First things first, my priorities, strawberry lemonade.
zh: 首先，我最想要的，草莓柠檬水。

en: This is so good.
zh: 这个真的很好喝。

en: And banana chips, which I already started eating.
zh: 还有香蕉片，我已经开始吃了。

en: I want to make chicken stir fry tonight.
zh: 今晚我想做鸡肉炒菜。

en: So I got some bell peppers for that.
zh: 所以我买了一些彩椒。

en: Obviously I got chicken.
zh: 当然也买了鸡肉。

en: I also got some broccoli for that.
zh: 我还买了西兰花。

en: Other things include bread, oats, because I want to make overnight oats.
zh: 其他还有面包、燕麦，因为我想做隔夜燕麦。

en: I was literally in Trader Joe's looking up breakfast ideas because when I find a breakfast I like
zh: 我真的在乔氏超市里面一边逛一边查早餐的灵感，

en: I will eat that every day for probably about three months until I'm sick of it.
zh: 因为一旦我找到一种喜欢的早餐，我会每天吃它，可能会持续三个月，直到吃腻为止。

en: And then I move on and I discard it.
zh: 然后我就会换掉，放弃它。

en: The current breakfast has been yogurt with berries, which is good.
zh: 我现在的早餐是酸奶加浆果，味道不错。

en: It's been too long.
zh: 但吃得太久了。

en: You know, this is a cyclical thing.
zh: 你懂的，这是个循环。

en: The cycle is done with my yogurt.
zh: 我和酸奶的周期已经结束了。

en: I've developed an aversion to it now because I've had it so much
zh: 我现在甚至有点反感它了，因为吃太多了，

en: and I need to find my next breakfast.
zh: 所以我需要找下一种早餐。

en: I hope that I like this. I'm sure I will.
zh: 希望我会喜欢这个。我应该会的。

en: I used to eat these often.
zh: 我以前经常吃这个。

en: Overnight oats with some berries and nuts.
zh: 加了浆果和坚果的隔夜燕麦。

en: I got chia seeds for that too.
zh: 我还专门买了奇亚籽。

en: And some granola because I thought maybe I put granola on top.
zh: 还有一些燕麦粒，我想着或许可以撒在上面。

en: I also got these sunflower seed butter cups.
zh: 我还买了这种向日葵籽黄油杯。

en: They're really good.
zh: 味道真的不错。

en: I'm probably gonna have one now.
zh: 我现在可能就要吃一个。

en: I actually like the peanut butter ones better.
zh: 其实我更喜欢花生酱口味的。

en: Don't get these.
zh: 别买这个。

en: Okay, well, fail.
zh: 好吧，失败了。

en: I got more peanut butter because I ran out.
zh: 我还买了花生酱，因为我吃完了。

en: And some fries.
zh: 还有一些薯条。

en: And lastly, stir fry sauce for my stir fry that I'm gonna make for dinner tonight.
zh: 最后，我买了炒菜酱，用来做今晚的炒菜。

en: That's my little haul.
zh: 这就是我这次的小采购啦。
